sentences.text:
This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant, as he has been arrested on 03.07.2023 in connection with Crime No.374/2023 registered at Police Station Jhansi Road, District Gwalior (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 376,
376(2)
(n), 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
Prosecution case, in brief, is that on 28.06.2023 minor prosecutrix aged about 17 years lodged an Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31686808/
1 FIR against the applicant to the effect that about six months ago on 15.01.2023, the applicant on the false pretext of giving certain documents took her in a hotel's room at Dabra and forcefully committed sexual intercourse with her.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: Thereafter, about five months ago, he again took the prosecutrix in a hotel's room at Gandhi Nagar and forcefully committed sexual intercourse with her.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: He also threatened to kill her, if she discloses the same.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the matter.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: He further submits that as per prosecution case itself, the applicant and prosecutrix are known to each other.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix was major at the time of incident.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: She has not given any plausible explanation about the delayed FIR, which itself shows the prosecution story doubtful.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: DNA report is also negative.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 03.07.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: His custodial interrogation or trial is not required in the matter.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: Trial will take time for its conclusion.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Hence,
prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application and submits that the prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: The offence is serious in nature, therefore, he be not released on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Having considered the rival submissions, material pointed out by learned counsel for the applicant,
specially the delayed FIR, so also considering the other facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, hence, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
